projects.title: Modern Luxury Villa
projects.description: A beautifully designed luxury villa that blends modern architecture with open spaces, natural light and elegant finishes to create a comfortable and stylish living experience.

images.alt: Villa exterior with pool at dusk
Open living room with sofa seating
Dining area with warm pendant lighting

paragraphs: This modern luxury villa is designed to offer a perfect balance of aesthetics, functionality, and comfort. The spacious layout, modern architecture, and premium interiors create an inviting atmosphere for contemporary living. Every detail, from lighting to material selection, is thoughtfully planned to provide a luxurious and comfortable lifestyle.
The design emphasizes open spaces, natural light, and seamless indoor–outdoor connectivity, making it an ideal home for modern families who value both style and practicality.

image.alt: Modern living room with sectional sofa, wall-mounted TV and warm cove lighting

projects.title: Corporate Office Building
projects.description: A modern office building designed for productivity, collaboration and growth, featuring contemporary architecture with sustainable and functional spaces.

images.alt: Evening architectural lighting of the complex

paragraphs: This flagship corporate office building combines high-performance glazing, acoustic zoning, and flexible floor plates to support dynamic teams and client hospitality.
With energy-efficient climate control, biophilic terrace breakout zones, and an iconic double-height lobby, the building sets a benchmark for sustainable commercial architecture.

highlights.title: Iconic Glass Facade
highlights.text: Double-glazed solar-control curtain wall for thermal efficiency.

highlights.title: Collaborative Zones
highlights.text: Modular workspaces, acoustic pods, and executive boardrooms.

highlights.title: Daylight Harvesting
highlights.text: Automated blinds and atrium light wells reduce energy usage.

highlights.title: Sky Terraces
highlights.text: Landscaped breakout decks on multiple levels for employee wellness.

specs.label: Key Highlights
specs.value: Double-Height Atrium, Smart BMS, Sky Terraces, LEED-Ready Systems

projects.title: Contemporary Home Interior
projects.description: Elegant and functional interiors designed to create a warm and inviting atmosphere, with modern finishes, smart space planning and premium materials.

images.alt: Contemporary living room with warm lighting
Dining pavilion and open kitchen layout

paragraphs: Crafted for a discerning family in South Delhi, this residence blends bespoke millwork, natural stone surfaces, and layered architectural lighting into a calm, cohesive sanctuary.
Every room transitions effortlessly into the next, utilizing concealed storage and custom-designed furniture to maximize both visual openness and everyday comfort.

highlights.title: Bespoke Millwork
highlights.text: Fluted walnut wall paneling and seamless concealed doors.

highlights.title: Curated Furnishings
highlights.text: Custom-upholstered seating and artisan stone tables.

highlights.title: Layered Lighting
highlights.text: Dimmable architectural cove lighting and warm accent fixtures.

highlights.title: Balcony Sanctuary
highlights.text: Indoor-outdoor plant styling and private sit-out deck.

specs.label: Key Highlights
specs.value: Custom Joinery, Italian Marble Flooring, Smart Lighting, Acoustic Suite
